name: agent-primitives
description: Portable agent patterns — reviewers, gates, and workflows that deploy to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any AGENTS.md harness from one source of truth.

plugins.name: verification-gate
plugins.description: Two read-only reviewers that run before an agent may declare a task done: verification-critic (reward-hacking and spec drift) and architecture-reviewer (structural decay). Optional Stop hook refuses to end a turn on red Tier-1 gates.

plugins.name: prose-tell-scan
plugins.description: Deterministic prose measurement: a catalogued scan for AI writing tells plus the cadence metrics a model cannot estimate about its own output. Register-aware, calibrated against your own corpus, and report-only — signals for an author about their own draft, never a verdict about who wrote something. Ships no rewriter, by design.

plugins.name: prose-review
plugins.description: Read-only critics for prose, run before a draft is called done. v0.1 ships prose-voice-critic: does this sound like the author, judged against their own corpus, with every finding required to cite how they write instead. Never judges quality, never claims anything about who wrote something.

plugins.name: prose-author
plugins.description: Scoped generation in a specific person's voice, drafted against their own corpus and voice card rather than a list of words to avoid. Verifies in the author's own measured terms and refuses to compare against fallbacks when no corpus exists. Never claims the output sounds like the author.
